== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The Blue [[Divine Titan]] is a massive, building-sized mech that represents highly advanced [[Aethertech]]. Its construction features smooth blue plating that connects in a manner similar to an insect's shell, and its helmet is designed with a hood-like appearance. The machine is relatively slender and is accompanied by a large staff that serves as a primary component of its design. This entity is specifically engineered to function alongside elemental magic, particularly [[water elementalism]], and it possesses the ability to enhance all forms of [[Aether manipulation]]. While it can work with other types of magic, its design is optimized for use in conjunction with elemental arts to compete against [[D’Niss]] magic.}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The Blue [[Divine Titan]] is a metal behemoth characterized by its bright blue, smooth plates and a helmet design that resembles a hood. As an advanced form of [[Aethertech]], this entity possesses the ability to amplify all acts of [[Aether manipulation]]. It is equipped with a massive staff and features an opening chest plate that reveals a specialized pilot's seat. Ultimately, operating such a machine requires a fundamental relationship between the Knight and the [[Titan]].}}
